{{Quote|I greet you as Drall's ambassador to Talus.|Champhra Biahin|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Champhra Biahin''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall/Legends|Drall's]] ambassador to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], where he lived in the town of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]]. He could often be found in the [[Dearic Medical Center]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] Biahin was trying to secure a specimen of the [[Twin-Scented Natterbloom]], a native Talusian herb. The herb was considered a possible cure for an ancient Drall disease, the [[Balding Sickness]]. The local [[Dearic Garden Club]] kindly helped Biahin in his efforts and located a specimen of the herb in the Talusian wilderness. Biahin paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] 25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to meet with the club's representative in the wilderness near Dearic and bring a sample of the Natterbloom to him. As a token of gratitude Biahin asked the spacer to deliver a recording of the anthem ''[[Flowers of Drall]]'' sung by young students at the [[Boiling Sea Music Academy]] on Drall to the Garden Club's chairperson. She paid the spacer 30 credits for his services.

==Behind the scenes==
Champhra Biahin is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He can be found in the Dearic Medial Center on Talus, where she offers two simple quests to players. The first mission is to travel to specified coordinates in the wilderness outside Dearic, meet with an NPC to receive the Natterbloom and report back to Biahin. The second mission is to travel into the wilderness with a datadisc of the anthem and talk to the chairperson before returning to Biahin.
